questions.question: In your Project Accountant role with Jacobs Engineering Group, how did you perform weekly cash counts and monthly bank reconciliations, and how did you investigate discrepancies?
Describe your process for entering transactions into WEBFCR and ensuring that supporting documentation was complete and properly uploaded.
You prepared monthly cash forecasts and budget requests. What information did you use, and how did you communicate anticipated funding needs to the home office?
Tell us about your experience reviewing vendor and subcontractor invoices for approval and payment. What checks did you perform before processing them?
How did you determine whether project expenses were reasonable, allowable, allocable, and coded to the appropriate general ledger account?

This role requires reconciliations and corrections in accordance with GAAP. What experience do you have preparing journal vouchers, including cash, bank, advance, or disbursement vouchers, and validating the underlying accounting?
Describe a weekly or monthly financial report you prepared for headquarters. What did it include, and how did you ensure the report and its backups were accurate?
When managing petty cash, cash books, and bank books, what controls did you follow to protect funds and maintain reliable records?
Give an example of a time you identified missing, incomplete, or inaccurate supporting documentation in an accounting transaction. How did you resolve it with the relevant personnel?
This position involves explaining financial results and variances to managers and clients. How would you prepare and present commentary on an unexpected expense or cash-flow variance?
